criteria_results.text: Before sending from an exact-owner projectless desktop chat, mobile may persist its profile/model execution state through the selected routing project; owner identity remains exact and a different non-null project remains forbidden.
criteria_results.notes: The first physical send exposed the missing projectless state-update allowance. After the source correction and passing focused contract, the retry still returned 404 because the desktop-launched API used plain tsx and had not restarted to load the edited route.

process_issues.description: The manual retry was handed back while the desktop API process still held the pre-fix route implementation; source-tree checks did not prove the launched backend revision.
process_issues.detected_by: Physical iPhone repeated HTTP 404 at persist-session-state; process inspection showed PID 92226 was launched before the route edit and used plain tsx without watch mode; the same change passed against a freshly built isolated API.

issues.description: The route was described as hot-fixed and returned for device retry before proving that the physical phone's desktop-launched API had loaded the corrected source.
issues.detected_by: Transcript review plus API process start-time and command inspection.

failure_output: Physical iPhone: request failed 404. Metro trace: stage=persist-session-state, code=HTTP_404, status=404. The corrected isolated backend subsequently passed the projectless state-update live test.
suggested_follow_up: Before every physical-device retry of a backend correction, restart the desktop-launched API and gate handoff on both health and a revision-specific behavioral probe.
